reason: Connected stores each bond in both directions, so matching atom 19 on either role counts the same bond twice; only the first atom role should be matched.
It counts bond connections that have a double bond rather than the atoms of molecules with a double bond, so the carbon share is computed over the wrong population.
It counts distinct atoms that are carbon over distinct atoms in molecules having a double bond, times 100, which is the percentage asked for.
It counts Connected rows whose first atom id matches 'TR%_19', one per connection of atom 19.

It counts Connected rows with first atom id like 'TR%_19', the same as tox-04 and the connections of atom 19.
The double-bond condition is not bracketed, so '* 100 / ...' attaches to the '=' value and the percentage is not computed as intended.
Counting a path counts its end, so it counts Bonds rather than Atoms, giving a ratio of bonds instead of the carbon atom percentage.
